resources.string: Choose your target, then enter your current body measurements.
Your steps stay active through the notification bar, even while you use other apps.
This device does not provide a step sensor, so live step tracking is unavailable.
Activity recognition permission is needed to count your steps.
Live StepCalc steps, calories and goal progress
